coalesce_ms.description: Debounce window for entity updates in ms. 0=immediate processing

embedder_type.description: Embedder type (bm25 or http). HTTP requires model registry with embedding capability

max_text_len.description: Max characters of source text embedded per entity; text beyond is truncated at a word boundary. 0 uses a per-embedder default (4000 bm25 / 8000 neural)

startup_attempts.description: Max attempts to wait for dependencies at startup

startup_interval_ms.description: Interval between startup attempts in milliseconds

text_suffixes.description: Predicate suffixes to extract for embedding (e.g. .source_code .signature). Defaults to common text predicates

workers.description: Number of concurrent embedding worker goroutines
